主要内容: On September 12, 2019, the Board of Directors of Asta Funding, Inc. appointed Mr. Steven Leidenfrost as Chief Financial Officer, effective September 23, 2019. Mr. Leidenfrost has over 25 years of experience in banking, capital markets, management consulting, and public accounting. Prior to joining Asta Funding, he was an Executive Director at Morgan Stanley, holding roles such as Global Tax Controller, Head of Disclosure Policy, and Head of SEC Reporting. He also worked as an auditor and consultant with KPMG. Mr. Leidenfrost is a Certified Public Accountant and has been a member of the SEC Committee at the New York State Society of Certified Public Accountants since July 2009. His base salary is $250,000, subject to annual increases, and he is eligible for cash and non-cash bonuses at the Board's discretion.
